_about: Netherlands: what holds in the whole country. A dynamic (day-ahead) supply contract is assumed: import at the day-ahead price plus taxes and transport, export at the day-ahead price. Merged under the grid area and grid operator files.

day_ahead.note: the day-ahead price of each 15 minutes (input column 'Day ahead kWh', EUR/kWh); no supplier margin modelled

energy_tax.note: Energiebelasting 2026, staffel 4 (50,001-10,000,000 kWh/yr): 37.35 EUR/MWh, applied to every imported kWh (one bracket rate, no bracket structure). Source: Vattenfall Grootzakelijk, tarieven 2026

export.note: exports paid at the day-ahead price, negative prices included (PV must run, so a surplus at a negative price costs money unless the battery stores it)
